rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when a claim, explanation, or story is not credible.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gaai2 sik1 m4 ho2 seon3

rows.note: Use this more formal expression for something impossible to believe, especially in emphatic reactions or writing.

example.english: It is unbelievable that the accident injured so many people.
example.traditional: 事故造成咁多人受傷，實在難以置信。
example.jyutping: si6 gu3 zou6 sing4 gam3 do1 jan4 sau6 soeng1 sat6 zoi6 naan4 ji5 zi3 seon3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice for something astonishing, extreme, or amazingly impressive rather than literally unbelievable.

example.english: Your new phone takes such great photos—it’s unbelievable!
example.traditional: 你部新電話影相咁靚，真係誇張！
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 san1 din6 waa2 jeng2 soeng2 gam3 leng3 zan1 hai6 kwaa1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when an excuse, claim, or situation is implausibly outrageous or far beyond what is acceptable.

example.english: They were two hours late and still blamed traffic; it was unbelievable.
example.traditional: 佢遲到兩個鐘仲話塞車，真係離譜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci4 dou3 loeng5 go3 zung1 zung6 waa6 sak1 ce1 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2
